anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view apply to active filters when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear - every workspace switch removes all active filters, so each workspace opens unfiltered
B) preserve - all active filters carry across switches, which is what the workspace-change handler does today
C) restore - each workspace reopens with the filters it last had, which needs new per-workspace filter state
Recommendation: B - it keeps the view's current behavior and adds no new state.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
What should happen to report filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves current behavior and avoids introducing per-workspace filter state.
